summary: First full test pass on VoltMart (API-first electronics store). Backend: created /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py with 40 pytest cases covering auth (email/password, register, role-escalation, phone OTP, JWT guards), /api/config themes+layouts, catalog (search/category/brand/sort/price/pagination/detail+related/404), cart CRUD + coupon min-order rules, checkout (mock=paid, cod=pending, cart clearing, totals math), order ownership 403, admin CRUD (products/categories/coupons/users/roles/analytics + 403 for non-admins), delivery assign/status-flow/authorization. 39/40 passed. Frontend: verified home (all 5 layouts + 5 themes render and restyle), login (email, phone OTP with debug_otp, registration, session persistence, logout), PDP video rendering, full purchase journey (add to cart -> qty change -> checkout with MEGA25 coupon -> order confirmed VM159870 -> visible in My Orders), admin panel all 7 tabs (Overview charts, Product create/edit/delete via dialog, Orders assign to partner, Users role change, Coupons create, Categories, Appearance theme+layout persistence to storefront), and delivery dashboard advancing placed->confirmed->picked_up->in_transit->delivered. Two real defects found: (1) CRITICAL - the entire /products listing page is broken (HTTP 422) so search/category/deal browsing is unusable; (2) the ASW comb product in the DB has no 'video' field (seed does not backfill existing docs), so its product video never renders.

minor.issue: Optional[int] 'deal' rejects empty string with 422. Backend is technically correct but too strict for a headless API consumed by web/Flutter clients; accepting empty string (or making it a bool/str) would remove a whole class of client bugs. This currently 422s every request the Products page makes.

Seed is skip-if-exists by title, so newly added fields on already-seeded products are never applied. The ASW AS-C603 comb doc in Mongo has no 'video' key even though ASW_COMB defines one (URL itself is valid, returns 200 video/mp4). Use an upsert/$set for video+images instead of insert-only.
No stock validation anywhere: cart and POST /api/orders accept qty far above product 'stock' (added 20 units of an item with stock 2 successfully) and stock is never decremented after an order.
payment_method is a free-text string; any value other than 'mock' silently becomes payment_status=pending (e.g. 'razorpay' or a typo). Should be a validated enum.

allow_credentials=True combined with allow_origins=['*'] is an invalid CORS combination (browsers ignore credentials). App works because auth is Bearer-only, but cookie fallback in get_current_user would never work cross-origin. Use explicit origins from env.
Review request states 15 ASW products; actual seeded count is 14 (12 flashlights + 1 comb + 1 blender). Doc/expectation mismatch, not a code bug.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: /products always fails with 422 -> React error overlay / permanent loading state; no products ever render. Root cause: load() sends deal: '' (and Products has no try/catch so the promise rejection leaves loading=true). Affects header search, all category nav links (nav-cat-*), category rails, 'View all' and /products?deal=1. Fix: send deal only when truthy (deal: deal || undefined) and wrap load() in try/catch with an error state.
No [data-testid=pdp-video] for ASW AS-C603 comb because the stored product lacks the video field (backend seed issue). AS-9509 and blender videos render correctly.
Console error on every open: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for accessibility' (missing DialogTitle/VisuallyHidden).

Delete buttons (trash icons) and the 'Add Category' button have no data-testid, so deletion can only be targeted via fragile text/DOM selectors (my UI delete step timed out for this reason; deletion works at API level).

integration_issues.issue: Every call from Products.jsx to GET /api/products returns 422 (deal=''), so search results, category pages and deals pages are all empty and throw an unhandled axios rejection.

issues: Revenue Trend line chart shows a single lone dot with no line when only one day of orders exists - looks broken/empty; consider an area fill or 'not enough data' hint.
Top Selling Products bar labels are truncated/overlapping at 9px font for long ASW titles.
Address form has no 'state' field while the order payload/address is free-form; My Orders shows 'City - Pincode' only. Minor completeness gap.
Razorpay option is visibly present but permanently disabled - acceptable for demo but should be labelled clearly as unavailable.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix Products.jsx query params - do not send deal:'' (send only truthy filters) and add try/catch + error UI so a failed products call doesn't hang on the loading spinner. This currently breaks all browsing/search.
Backfill the ASW comb's 'video' (and any other newly added fields) with an upsert in seed(), since insert-only seeding skips existing docs.
Add stock validation/decrement on cart add and order creation (qty > stock currently allowed, stock never reduced).
Validate payment_method as an enum ('mock' | 'cod' | 'razorpay') instead of free text.
Fix CORS: allow_credentials=True with allow_origins=['*'] is invalid; use explicit origin(s) from env.
Add DialogTitle to AuthModal DialogContent to clear the a11y console error.
Add data-testid to admin coupon/category delete buttons and the Add Category button.
critical_code_review_comments: Products.jsx load() has no error handling; any API failure leaves loading=true forever with no user-visible message. Every page that calls an API should have loading/error states (Home, Admin tabs also swallow errors silently, e.g. adminApi.analytics().then() with no .catch()).
server.py is 675 lines with seed data, models, and all routers in one file - split into routers/ (auth, catalog, cart, orders, admin) and seed/data modules before it grows further.
Seed functions are not idempotent for field updates (only 'insert if title missing'), which already caused a data drift bug (comb video).
PUT /api/admin/products/{pid} and DELETE endpoints return 200 even when the id doesn't exist (update_one/delete_one matched 0). Should 404 on missing resources.
Cart 'add' merges qty without any max/stock cap; enrich_cart silently drops items whose product was deleted without notifying the user.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (auth, PDP, purchase journey, admin panel, delivery all pass; the entire /products browse page fails)

Role changes made during testing were reverted (only 'Arjun Delivery' remains a delivery partner); active theme/layout restored to hyper_retail/layout_mega_mall.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -p no:randomly -q. Only TestCatalog::test_videos_present should fail until the comb video is backfilled. Frontend: the /products page could NOT be exercised (422 loop) - after the main agent fixes the deal:'' param, retest search, category filter, brand filter, sort dropdown, price slider and add-to-cart from the listing grid (all previously untested). Purchase journey, admin panel tabs, appearance switching, phone OTP, and the delivery status flow were all verified working; order VM159870 is already delivered, so create a fresh order before retesting delivery. Leftover TEST_/qa_ui_ users exist in Admin > Users (no user-delete API).
rca_of_the_issue: 1) /products 422: Products.jsx builds its query as {category, search, deal, sort, brand, min_price, max_price} where deal defaults to '' (params.get('deal') || ''). axios serialises the empty string, and FastAPI's `deal: Optional[int]` fails int_parsing -> 422 for every request; because load() has no catch, React shows the dev error overlay (whose iframe also blocks clicks) and loading never resolves. Reproduce: curl '<BACKEND>/api/products?deal=' -> 422. 2) Missing comb video: seed() only inserts ASW_COMB when no doc with that title exists; the doc was created before the video field was added, so Mongo still has no 'video' key (verified directly in Mongo; the .mp4 URL returns 200). Mitigation: upsert with $set for video/images on every startup.
